content:
maria_ng: FYI Acme (org: 874) reporting console graphs not loading for ~30m. Panels just spin then UI shows 500 from analytics API. Can someone take a look? :rotating_light:

sam_k: which panels / time range? any repro steps?

maria_ng: All dashboard panels under 'Sales KPIs' fail. Time range 7d, top-level chart (panel id 412). Network tab: POST /api/analytics/query -> 500 response. Customer says started ~08:10 UTC.

olivia: I can repro locally on staging with the same panel id and time range. Response body is short: `{"error":"internal server error"}`. curl example:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/api/analytics/query \\n  -H 'authorization: Bearer <token>' \\n  -d '{"panel_id":412,"from":"-7d","to":"now"}'
```

support-bot: Created ticket SUP-2026-867. Notifying oncall.

sam_k: Checked analytics-proxy logs around 2026-03-17T08:10: server returns 502 when proxy tries to talk to metrics-store, then 500 bubbled to UI. Snippet:

```
[2026-03-17T08:11:02Z] proxy.request id=tx-9f3c conn=pool-12 upstream=metrics-store timeout=30s status=502
[2026-03-17T08:11:02Z] proxy.error id=tx-9f3c upstream_err=timeout
```

jayden: metrics-store shards report increased p99 CPU and some compaction pauses. Could be a heavy cardinality aggregation from this query.

eng-oncall: I'm on it. Early hypothesis: 7d with high-cardinality breakdown + group-by is triggering a long running aggregation that hits our upstream timeout and triggers 502 -> UI 500. Short term mitigation: lower time range or use the summary endpoint which hits pre-aggregates.

maria_ng: Customer asks for workaround while you diagnose. Can we advise them to change time range to 24h?

eng-oncall: Yes — workaround validated. On staging, panel loads when switching to `1d` or using `/api/analytics/summary?panel_id=412`. Example pre-agg call: `GET /api/analytics/summary?panel_id=412&range=24h` returns quickly.

olivia: Also confirmed that setting UI query concurrency to 1 (in dev console) avoids the spike and panels load, so concurrent queries amplify the problem.

sam_k: Temporary fix plan: increase proxy upstream timeout to 60s and add a 504->UI-friendly error message while we root-cause. I'll open PR for the proxy timeout and an immediate UI change to show a retry button instead of raw 500.

maria_ng: Important — this is impacting a paying customer. Marking as P1 for support. I'll update SUP-2026-867 with the workaround and ETA.

eng-oncall: Next steps: 1) patch proxy timeout + UI retry (ETA 2h), 2) add query limiter + prefer pre-aggregate for known heavy panels (follow-up design), 3) dig into metrics-store compaction schedules for root cause.

ops-bot: Deployment to staging started by jayden.

jayden: Deploying proxy timeout bump to canary now. Will monitor error rates.

maria_ng: Thanks — please keep this thread updated and ping incidents if we elevate. I'll send the customer the 24h workaround and the summary endpoint as a workaround. :white_check_mark:
